---

`message_content.type` has the following list of well-known values. If one of them applies, then the respective value MUST be used; otherwise, a custom value MAY be used.

| Value | Description | Stability |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `text` | Text content. | ![Development](https://img.shields.io/badge/-development-blue) |
| `image` | Image content. | ![Development](https://img.shields.io/badge/-development-blue) |
| `audio` | Audio content. | ![Development](https://img.shields.io/badge/-development-blue) |
| `video` | Video content. | ![Development](https://img.shields.io/badge/-development-blue) |
| `document` | Document content, e.g. a PDF, an uploaded file, or inline text. | ![Development](https://img.shields.io/badge/-development-blue) |
| `reasoning` | Reasoning or thinking content, including redacted reasoning. | ![Development](https://img.shields.io/badge/-development-blue) |
| `tool_use` | A tool call returned as an ordered content part. | ![Development](https://img.shields.io/badge/-development-blue) |
